name: outlook-personal-mcp
description: Read-only access to a personal Outlook.com mailbox via Microsoft Graph.
long_description: Search and read a personal Outlook.com / hotmail.com / live.com mailbox. Authenticates through Microsoft's consumer OAuth endpoint so personal Microsoft accounts can sign in. Read-only (Mail.Read); tokens are cached locally and never leave your machine.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Fetch the full content of one message by id.

client_id.title: Azure Application (client) ID
client_id.description: The Application (client) ID from your Microsoft Entra app registration (see README for setup).

redirect_port.title: OAuth redirect port
redirect_port.description: Loopback port for the sign-in redirect. Must match the redirect URI registered in Azure.
